ticket.subject: Mail visible online only
ticket.description: I see today's messages in the browser mailbox, but my desktop client shows yesterday's mail and says Work Offline. No password change occurred.

review_notes: Client offline check/restart once applies. No identity reset, profile deletion, or login escalation. Attribute symptoms to ticket.

ticket.subject: Can read shared inbox but cannot send as it
ticket.description: I can read the shared mailbox. Sending with its address fails. I do not know whether the owner approved Send As permission.

review_notes: Verify Send As specifically, owner approval/delegation separate from read access. Ask mailbox and permission details; no password sharing or reinstall.

ticket.subject: One office workstation unreachable remotely
ticket.description: Corporate VPN is connected and internal websites work. Only workstation DESK-27 cannot be reached. Other remote destinations are reachable.

review_notes: Target-name/power check and Endpoint Support report apply. Do not refresh all VPN routes as though all internal destinations fail; do not reboot another user's workstation.

ticket.subject: Expired password with verification available
ticket.description: The identity portal says my password expired. My registered verification method is available. How should I change it before trying desktop email again?

review_notes: Identity portal Forgotten password, registered verification, new unique password before client retry. No unavailable-verification handoff or assertion that reset already succeeded.

ticket.subject: Cannot verify forgotten password reset
ticket.description: I forgot my company password and have no registered verification method available. My manager says they can skip the identity check for me.

review_notes: Service desk identity verification remains necessary, manager cannot bypass. Do not give self-service steps that assume a working registered method or request secrets.

ticket.subject: Badge opens building but not secure print release
ticket.description: My badge works at the building entrance, yet secure print release does not recognize it. The printer asset label is PR-19.

review_notes: Facilities verifies badge enrollment and IT checks print account link; label each handoff escalation. No company password reset or borrowed badge. Do not assert known cause.

ticket.subject: Lost encryption key for archived backups
ticket.description: The portal and MFA both work. I need Northstar's approved method to recover a missing encryption key for an archived server backup.

review_notes: MFA recovery and password reset are misleading neighbors, not a backup-key policy. No invented recovery/rotation commands or infrastructure contact.

ticket.subject: Guest office network and cafeteria payment
ticket.description: I am using Northstar-Guest Wi-Fi. What is the company process to refund a duplicate cafeteria card payment?

review_notes: Guest Wi-Fi or badge/print passages do not establish cafeteria refund policy. Abstain without inventing Facilities or reception routing.
